name: Salesfire
author: salesfire

sections.installation:
Install the plugin.

Go to Settings > Salesfire.

Enable tracking and enter your Salesfire ID.
sections.changelog:
1.0.15 – 2026-02-23

  • Fix fatal error in update_cart_quantity_event by using existing helper methods for brand and category retrieval.

1.0.14 – 2025-12-17

  • Ensure the get_the_terms usage has catering for all 3 returns values.
  • Added a method called get_product_brand for product brand retrieval.
  • Added a method called get_product_category for product category retrieval.

1.0.13 – 2025-12-02

  • Added add to cart and remove from cart tracking events.

1.0.12 – 2025-10-28

  • Fixed issue with sf_cuid cookie being set to incorrect value

1.0.11 – 2025-04-03

  • Fixed issue with setting sf_cuid cookie.

1.0.9 – 2025-03-27

  • Add product prefix to allow matching with product feed.
  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.7.2.

1.0.8 – 2025-01-23

  • Add deterministic tracking
  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.7.

1.0.7 – 2025-01-08

  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.7.

1.0.6 – 2023-11-06

  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.4.

1.0.5 – 2023-08-31

  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.3.1.

1.0.4 – 2022-08-18

  • Fixed tracking to use correct parent and product IDs and include quantity.

1.0.3 – 2022-08-09

  • Updated purchase tracking to subtract discount from revenue.

1.0.2 – 2022-03-08

  • Updated tracking to include platform event.

1.0.1 – 2022-01-31

  • Fix script injection timing.

1.0.0 – 2021-10-09

  • Initial release
